tenderSchedule.title: RFP for providing Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) for All HT & LT Control Panels, Transformers, Earth Pits, Substation Equipments, Electrical Fittings and Diesel Generator at IT Park Hubli
tenderSchedule.description: RFP for providing Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) for All HT(High Tension) & LT(Low Tension) Control Panels, Transformers, Earth Pits, Substation Equipments, Electrical Fittings and Diesel Generator at IT Park Hubli
tenderSchedule.deptName: Karnataka State Electronics Development Corporation Limited

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Karnataka State Electronics Development Corporation Limited Conference Room, First Floor, No 59, Kumara Park West Extension, Railway Parallel Road, Seshadripuram, Bengaluru 560020.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per the tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicant should be a Firm or Company registered in India. Joint Ventures and Consortiums are not allowed.
Applicant should have been in existence for a period of at least three (3) years

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- GST Registration / Certificate of Incorporation / LLP Registration / Partnership Registration

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicants should be registered with the Commercial Tax Department for GST and Should have filed GST Returns

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- GST returns filed for the Financial Year 2025-26 and the latest completed quarter preceding the date of submission of the bid.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicants should have PAN and should have filed Income Tax Returns for the preceding three financial years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Income Tax Returns for the preceding three financial years, i.e., FY 2022-23 (AY 2023-24),  FY 2023-24 (AY 2024-25) and  FY 2024-25 (AY 2025-26).

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicant should have an average annual turnover of Rs. 50 lakhs or more during the preceding three (3) financial years,i.e., FY 2022-23 (AY 2023-24) FY 2023-24 (AY 2024-25) FY 2024-25 (AY 2025-26)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Annual Turnover and Networth statement for the preceding three (3) financial years certified by Chartered Accountant with UDIN number
Others -- Audited Balance Sheet and Audited Profit & Loss Statement for the preceding three (3) financial years certified by Chartered Accountant.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have relevant experience as an electrical contractor with expertise in maintaining similar HT and LT control panels, transformers, earth pits, substation equipment, electrical fittings, and diesel generators in any state Government/ Central Government IT parks in previous three (3) financial years, i.e., FY 2022-23 (AY 2023-24) FY 2023-24 (AY 2024-25) FY 2024-25 (AY 2025-26) .

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- End User Certificate / Work Completion certificate / Satisfactory Performance Certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicants should have the approved licensed class-1 Electrical contractors having expertise & experience in maintaining similar HT & LT Control Panels, Transformers, Earth Pits, Substation Equipments, Electrical Fittings & Diesel Generator.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Valid  Class-1 Electrical Contractor certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Affidavit on Rs. 100 stamp paper, notarized, declaring the authenticity of documents, non-blacklisting confirmation, absence of legal disputes, compliance with RFP terms, and consequences of violation.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Affidavit as per format enclosed in RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicants should submit a self-declared Litigation Declaration Form on their letter head along with notarized.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Litigation Declaration Form as per format enclosed in RFP.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicants should have its office & service centre located in Hubli.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Rent agreement in the applicant name

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Any additional documents requested in the Tender Document
